component.title: GlobalCommandSystem
component.purpose: GlobalCommandSystem makes one scoped command registration drive keyboard invocation, discovery, execution, history, and recovery.

states.description: A launcher exposes the command affordance without stealing focus.
The palette can preserve its surface while command data is prepared.
No-match feedback remains useful and keyboard-operable.
Command refresh or execution failure remains explicit and retryable.

claims.statement: Commands registered once are discoverable through the palette and invokable through the scoped shortcut registry.
Opening focuses search, arrow keys move the active command, Enter executes it, and Escape restores the prior focus target.
Empty and request-error states preserve the command surface and expose useful recovery copy instead of silently disappearing.
